For centuries, humans have been fascinated by migration—the seasonal movement of animals from one place to another. While many people are familiar with bird migrations, fewer realize that insects also engage in long-distance travel. One of the most remarkable examples is the migration of the monarch butterfly. These butterflies travel thousands of kilometers each year, moving between Canada, the United States, and Mexico.■Scientists have studied this journey for decades, but many mysteries remain.

Monarchs face numerous challenges during migration. [HIGHLIGHT]They must navigate extreme temperatures, predators, and the loss of habitat caused by human activity.[END] Despite these difficulties, monarchs continue their annual journey with extraordinary accuracy. Some researchers believe the butterflies navigate using the position of the sun, while others suggest that they rely on Earth’s magnetic field. Regardless of the exact mechanism, their ability to stay on course is considered one of nature’s most impressive achievements.

In recent years, climate change has added new dangers to monarch migration. Rising temperatures can disrupt the timing of their journey. Additionally, unusual weather patterns may destroy the milkweed plants that monarch larvae depend on for survival.■Without these plants, young butterflies cannot grow, leading to a decline in the population.

Conservationists have begun planting milkweed gardens and creating protected habitats to support the species. These efforts have shown promising results in some regions.■However, experts warn that long-term success will require international cooperation, since monarchs migrate across multiple countries. Their journey reminds us that protecting wildlife often involves more than local action—it requires understanding how ecosystems across the world are connected.

modules.passage:
Many people believe that creativity is something we are born with, but research shows that creativity can be developed like any other skill. Creative thinking often begins with curiosity—the desire to explore new ideas and possibilities. Children, for example, constantly ask questions about the world around them.■This natural curiosity is the foundation of creative problem-solving.

As people grow older, creativity can decline because they become more cautious or afraid of making mistakes. [HIGHLIGHT]However, studies show that creativity increases when people allow themselves to think freely without worrying about being judged.[END] This is why brainstorming sessions encourage individuals to generate ideas without filtering them.

Another factor that boosts creativity is exposure to different experiences. Traveling, reading diverse books, or meeting new people can all provide fresh perspectives.■These experiences help individuals combine ideas in new and unexpected ways.

Modern workplaces have begun recognizing the importance of creativity. Companies now design offices with open spaces, bright colors, and comfortable seating to inspire employees.■Some businesses even schedule “innovation hours” where workers focus solely on exploring new concepts. By supporting creative thinking, organizations hope to find better solutions and remain competitive in a rapidly changing world.

Gardening has become one of the most popular hobbies in recent years. Many people are turning to gardening as a way to relax, reduce stress, and reconnect with nature. One reason for this trend is that gardening provides a sense of accomplishment. When individuals plant seeds and watch them grow, they experience a feeling of pride.■This emotional reward motivates them to continue gardening.

Another reason gardening has grown in popularity is its health benefits. Spending time outdoors exposes people to sunlight, which helps the body produce vitamin D. [HIGHLIGHT]Vitamin D is important for strengthening bones and improving mood.[END] Additionally, gardening involves physical activities like digging, watering, and planting—these movements help improve flexibility and strength.

Gardening also offers an opportunity to grow fresh fruits and vegetables. Eating home-grown produce is healthier because it contains fewer chemicals and preservatives.■This encourages families to adopt better eating habits.

Furthermore, gardening helps communities connect. Many neighborhoods have community gardens where people work together to grow plants.■These gardens create shared spaces that encourage teamwork and social bonding. As a result, gardening not only benefits individuals but also strengthens the community as a whole.

Many people enjoy watching documentaries because they provide knowledge in an interesting way. Documentaries cover a wide range of topics, including history, science, wildlife, and technology.■They help viewers learn new information without feeling bored.

One major advantage of documentaries is that they use real-life footage. This makes learning feel more realistic and relatable. [HIGHLIGHT]When people see real events and interviews, they understand the topic more deeply.[END] For example, a documentary about space exploration often shows actual videos taken by astronauts.

Another benefit is that documentaries encourage critical thinking. They present facts from different perspectives and allow viewers to form their own opinions.■This helps students develop analytical skills that are useful in school and daily life.

Documentaries are also easily accessible. With streaming platforms and online videos, people can watch educational content anytime.■This convenience motivates more people to choose documentaries over regular entertainment. Overall, documentaries are an effective way to learn while staying engaged.

Online shopping has become extremely popular in recent years. People enjoy the convenience of ordering items from home without visiting physical stores.■This trend has grown rapidly due to technology and faster delivery services.

One major advantage of online shopping is the wide variety of products available. [HIGHLIGHT]Buyers can compare items, read reviews, and choose the best option within minutes.[END] This helps customers make smarter purchasing decisions.

Another benefit is that online stores often provide discounts that are not available in local shops.■This attracts budget-conscious buyers and makes online shopping even more appealing.

However, there are also disadvantages. Some people receive damaged or incorrect products. Others feel unsure about quality because they cannot see or touch the item before buying.■Despite these issues, online shopping continues to grow as companies improve their return policies and customer support.
